items.source: Default is true, leading to an exception if there is no payload. Switch to false to have null passed when there is no payload.
items.translation: 默认为 `true`，如果没有负载则会导致异常。切换为 `false` 以便在没有负载时传递 `null`。

items.source:
This attribute may or may not be supported depending on whether the message being
handled contains a non-primitive Object as its payload or is in serialized form and
requires message conversion.
items.translation: 此属性是否受支持取决于正在处理的消息是否包含非基本对象作为其负载，或者是否处于序列化形式并需要消息转换。

items.source: This attribute is not supported for:
items.translation: 此属性不支持以下项目：

items.source: Annotation that binds a method parameter to the payload of a message. Can also be used to associate a payload to a method invocation. The payload may be passed through a MessageConverter to convert it from serialized form with a specific MIME type to an Object matching the target method parameter.
items.translation: 绑定方法参数到消息负载的注解。也可用于将负载关联到方法调用。负载可通过 MessageConverter 传递，将其从具有特定 MIME 类型的序列化形式转换为与目标方法参数匹配的 Object。
WebSocket 上的 STOMP 消息

items.source: A SpEL expression to be evaluated against the payload object as the root context.
items.translation: 作为根上下文对负载对象进行求值的 SpEL 表达式。
